summary: Add TLS-skip-verify and base-URL construction for self-hosted UniFi OS gateways, auto-enabled for loopback/RFC1918/RFC4193/link-local hosts, overridable via UNIFI_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY.
reason: Self-hosted UniFi gateways serve a self-signed certificate on the local Network API by default, and the integration spec's servers[0].url is a bare relative path with no absolute host — the generator has no TLS-skip-verify or gateway-host base-URL support today, so a freshly generated CLI cannot talk to a real gateway out of the box. Every existing community tool for this API ships an equivalent manual opt-out.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood (--live --level full) passed 208/208 real commands against an actual UniFi OS gateway using this TLS/base-URL path.
